build_merged_tree: git fetch origin <branch> <target>; merge origin/<branch> into a scratch worktree cut from the target tip fetched at gate start; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build
focused_vs_full: A single-file or -t selector run only localizes a failure. The verdict rests on the whole test script.
zero_match_check: pnpm test --listTests (or the runner's list mode) must list the intended files; a selector that matches nothing must report zero tests

structural_checks.name: lockfile in sync
structural_checks.why: fails when package.json and the lockfile disagree
